abrams.label: The Revolver
abrams.body: Abrams' sidearm. In close quarters it fires a wide spread — the same close-range pressure that defines his Shoulder Charge.

abrams.label: The Tome
abrams.body: The mysterious book that arrived on his desk with a note scrawled in onyx blood: "Don't let them have it." It is the source of his Siphon Life ability.

abrams.label: Detective Abrams
abrams.body: A fixture of the New York investigating scene for years. Stolen art, missing persons, ritual murders — he solved them all before the Tome found him.

abrams.label: The Coat
abrams.body: Worn through years of detective work and now through firefights. The bulk and sustain to lead from the front.

abrams.label: The Cigar
abrams.body: A small comfort between cases. Some habits survive the supernatural.

infernus.label: The Flames
infernus.body: Infernus burns. His flames are both his weapon and his identity — a constant, searing presence on the battlefield.

infernus.label: The Flask
infernus.body: Carried at the hip. A small vessel of something volatile — the fuel for his fire.

infernus.label: Infernus
infernus.body: A being of fire and fury. Where he walks, the ground scorches.

infernus.label: The Hand
infernus.body: Even fire needs a guiding hand. Infernus directs his flames with precision.

wraith.label: The Cards
wraith.body: Wraith's cards are her weapon and her calling card. Each one carries a trick — and a debt.

wraith.label: The Pistol
wraith.body: A sidearm for when the cards aren't enough. Quick, precise, and deadly at range.

wraith.label: Wraith
wraith.body: A woman of mystery and shadow. The cards chose her, and she chose to survive.

wraith.label: The Shawl
wraith.body: Worn like armor. A reminder of who she was before the cards found her.

viscous.label: The Eyes
viscous.body: Two points of awareness in an otherwise formless body. They track everything.

viscous.label: The Weapon
viscous.body: Even a blob needs a gun. Viscous wields his weapon with surprising precision.

viscous.label: The Muzzle
viscous.body: Where the shot comes from. Viscous can reshape his body to aim from unexpected angles.

viscous.label: The Goo
viscous.body: Viscous is a sentient mass of gel. He can split, reform, and absorb damage that would destroy a solid body.

shiv.label: The Blade
shiv.body: Shiv's weapon of choice. Close-range, brutal, and precise.

shiv.label: The Hair
shiv.body: A distinctive look. Part of the identity that Shiv projects.

shiv.label: Shiv
shiv.body: A warrior forged in the streets. Every scar tells a story.

shiv.label: The Cigar
shiv.body: A small comfort. Even in the heat of battle, some rituals remain.

celeste.label: The Baton
celeste.body: Celeste's instrument of control. It channels her spirit energy into devastating attacks.

celeste.label: The Grip
celeste.body: Where hand meets weapon. The point of control.

celeste.label: The Gaze
celeste.body: A performer at heart. Even in combat, there is a theatrical quality to everything she does.

celeste.label: Celeste
celeste.body: A star on the battlefield. Dazzling, disruptive, and deadly.
